title: A Message for Mira
label: ch:mr-a1-named-reader-message
canDo: I can write a 30-40-word Devanagari message to Mira for a familiar purpose, first without a timer and then under a three-minute task timer.

payoff.summary: After an untimed independent message and a partial timer, write the 30-40-word named-reader message within three minutes without a visible model.
payoff.note: This is timed message-task evidence only, not a 20-minute whole-paper mock or full A1 exam readiness.
